newsitem.title: USA: Alpine Lace Brands introduces fat-free ham.
newsitem.headline: Alpine Lace Brands introduces fat-free ham.

text.p: Alpine Lace Brands Inc said Tuesday it is introducing fat-free ham and 97 percent fat-free roast beef.
The marketer of reduced-fat and low-salt cheeses is testing the new products in select markets and plans to introduce them nationally in early 1998.

"By legal definition the ham is fat free," said vice president of operations Dominick Gonnella in an interview. He added the U.S. Department of Agriculture guidelines hold companies can call hams fat free if they contain less than 0.5 gram per serving size (two ounces, or about 56 grams) of fat.
